Review the code changes against the base branch 'main'. The merge base commit for this comparison is c6fc04ffe16ef9c85777639c3c68b6eff46b8b0d. Run `git diff c6fc04ffe16ef9c85777639c3c68b6eff46b8b0d` to inspect the changes relative to main. Provide prioritized, actionable findings.

input.input: const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"git status --short && git diff --stat c6fc04ffe16ef9c85777639c3c68b6eff46b8b0d && git diff --name-only c6fc04ffe16ef9c85777639c3c68b6eff46b8b0d","workdir":"/Users/gtrrz-victor/wks/cli/cli","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":20000}); text(r.output)

const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"git diff --find-renames --find-copies c6fc04ffe16ef9c85777639c3c68b6eff46b8b0d -- cmd/entire/cli/agent/claudecode/lifecycle.go cmd/entire/cli/agent/claudecode/model.go cmd/entire/cli/agent/claudecode/model_test.go cmd/entire/cli/strategy/manual_commit_condensation_test.go","workdir":"/Users/gtrrz-victor/wks/cli/cli","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":40000}); text(r.output)

const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"sed -n '190,235p' cmd/entire/cli/agent/agent.go; sed -n '250,300p' cmd/entire/cli/strategy/manual_commit_condensation.go; sed -n '770,820p' cmd/entire/cli/strategy/manual_commit_condensation.go; sed -n '1,90p' cmd/entire/cli/agent/pi/transcript.go; sed -n '1,210p' cmd/entire/cli/agent/claudecode/transcript.go; sed -n '1,100p' cmd/entire/cli/agent/claudecode/types.go","workdir":"/Users/gtrrz-victor/wks/cli/cli","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":30000}); text(r.output)

const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"rg -n '\"model\"|isSidechain|is_sidechain|subtype\":\"init' cmd/entire/cli/agent/claudecode --glob '*test*' --glob '*.jsonl' | head -300","workdir":"/Users/gtrrz-victor/wks/cli/cli","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":30000}); text(r.output)

const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
import json,glob,collections,os
for f in glob.glob('cmd/entire/cli/transcript/compact/testdata/claude_full*.jsonl'):
 c=collections.Counter(); side=collections.Counter(); pts=collections.Counter()
 for raw in open(f):
  try:x=json.loads(raw)
  except:continue
  if x.get('type')=='assistant':
   m=x.get('message',{}).get('model','')
   c[m]+=1
   side[(x.get('isSidechain'),m)]+=1
   pts[(x.get('parent_tool_use_id'), x.get('parentToolUseID'),m)]+=1
 print(os.path.basename(f), 'models',c)
 print('side',side)
 print('parent ids nonnull',[(k,v) for k,v in pts.items() if k[0] or k[1]][:20])
PY
rg -n '"isSidechain":true.*"type":"assistant"|"type":"assistant".*"isSidechain":true' cmd/entire/cli/transcript/compact/testdata --glob 'claude*.jsonl' | head -20","workdir":"/Users/gtrrz-victor/wks/cli/cli","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":20000}); text(r.output)
